Confidence thresholds from the calibration model

Source: R/calibrated_thresholds.R
calibrated_thresholds.Rd

Derives a confidence threshold for each site x species from the calibration model of stage 2 (fit_calibration()), instead of from the reviewed clips of each cell alone, as suggest_thresholds() does. The calibration model is the logistic regression of the verdict on the logit of the score proposed by the BirdNET authors (Wood & Kahl 2024, doi:10.1007/s10336-024-02144-5 ), with species and site effects, so a cell with few reviewed clips borrows strength from the others.

Usage

calibrated_thresholds(
  fit,
  target = 0.95,
  rule = c("probability", "precision"),
  scored = NULL,
  cells = NULL,
  min_confidence = 0.1,
  grid_step = 0.01,
  lower_prob = 0.05
)

Arguments

fit

A glm, glmerMod or brmsfit returned by fit_calibration().

target

Numeric scalar in (0, 1), target probability ("probability") or precision ("precision"). The default, 0.95, is the p_min of score_detections() and calibrate(), so that the probability threshold is the score equivalent of the cut on P(TP) used for the detection histories. It is the same for both rules; the "precision" threshold is lower for the same target (see Details). suggest_thresholds() uses 0.90 by default.

rule

Character scalar, one of "probability" (default) or "precision"; see Details.

scored

NULL or a data frame (or tibble) returned by score_detections(), one row per detection, with site, species, confidence and p_tp. Required for rule = "precision"; with rule = "probability", its site x species cells are used when cells is NULL.

cells

NULL or a data frame (or tibble) of the cells to threshold, one row per cell, with site and species and any other variable of the calibration formula. By default, the cells of scored or, without it, every site x species of the calibration.

min_confidence

Numeric scalar in [0, 1]. Detections below this confidence are not scored.

grid_step

Numeric scalar in (0, 0.5). Models fitted with engine = "brms": step of the grid of scores on which the posterior is computed.

lower_prob

Numeric scalar in (0, 1). Models fitted with engine = "brms": the probability of the lower quantile of the posterior of P(TP) used for threshold_lower.

Value

A tibble with the cell columns, threshold and, for rule = "probability", p_tp_at_threshold (and threshold_lower with a brms model); for rule = "precision", precision_at_threshold, n_above (detections kept) and n_detections. threshold is NA when no score of the grid reaches the target. With "precision", a cell can be NA while "probability" gives a threshold: the probability threshold may lie above every detection of the cell, and then no set of detections reaches the target.

Details

Two rules are available:

  • rule = "probability" (the rule of Wood & Kahl 2024): the lowest score c at which the calibrated probability that a detection is a true positive, P(TP | score = c, site, species), reaches target and stays at or above it for every higher score. Only the model is needed.

  • rule = "precision": the lowest score c at which the expected precision of the detections kept, the mean of P(TP) over every detection of the cell with a score >= c, reaches target and stays at or above it. It needs the scored detections of the selection tables (score_detections()), and answers the question that suggest_thresholds() answers with the reviewed clips: what share of the detections above the threshold are true? The threshold is lower than with "probability", because the detections above c have higher probabilities than a detection at c.

The candidate thresholds are the points of a grid of scores (step grid_step, from min_confidence), as in score_detections().

With a model fitted with engine = "brms", rule = "probability" also returns threshold_lower: the lowest score at which the lower quantile (lower_prob) of the posterior of P(TP) reaches target, a conservative threshold that accounts for the uncertainty of the calibration.

Which clips to review. The calibration models the verdict given the score. Choosing the clips to review by their score only (for instance, adding a second random sample from the higher scores, as Wood & Kahl 2024 suggest for species with few true detections) does not bias P(TP | score), as long as the model form is right; it does bias the precision computed directly from the reviewed clips, which suggest_thresholds() uses. The site-confirmation design of false-positive occupancy models needs instead clips drawn at random (sampling_mode = "random_detections" or "random_recordings" in select_clips()).

Site effects. With a site effect, P(TP | score, site) mixes the error of the classifier with how often the species calls at the site. For a threshold this is what is wanted: the precision at a site depends on both. It is not a measure of the classifier alone.

See also

suggest_thresholds() for thresholds from the reviewed clips of each cell; compare_thresholds() to put both side by side; calibrate(), which writes these thresholds to thresholds.csv.

Examples

ex <- system.file("extdata", "example", package = "sheepdog")
files <- list.files(file.path(ex, "validation"), full.names = TRUE)
sites <- c("ARA", "BAI", "NHE", "XAR")
tables <- setNames(file.path(ex, "birdnet", sites,
                             "BirdNET_SelectionTable.txt"), sites)
fit <- fit_calibration(read_validations(files),
                       calibration_models()$m2_species_slope)
#> 2467 reviewed clips (1577 TP / 890 FP) of 8 species at 4 sites.
scored <- score_detections(tables, fit)
#> Scoring ARA (/home/runner/work/_temp/Library/sheepdog/extdata/example/birdnet/ARA/BirdNET_SelectionTable.txt)...
#>   1753 detections of calibrated species (0 of species NOT calibrated were dropped).
#> Scoring BAI (/home/runner/work/_temp/Library/sheepdog/extdata/example/birdnet/BAI/BirdNET_SelectionTable.txt)...
#>   1427 detections of calibrated species (0 of species NOT calibrated were dropped).
#> Scoring NHE (/home/runner/work/_temp/Library/sheepdog/extdata/example/birdnet/NHE/BirdNET_SelectionTable.txt)...
#>   2507 detections of calibrated species (0 of species NOT calibrated were dropped).
#> Scoring XAR (/home/runner/work/_temp/Library/sheepdog/extdata/example/birdnet/XAR/BirdNET_SelectionTable.txt)...
#>   1866 detections of calibrated species (0 of species NOT calibrated were dropped).
calibrated_thresholds(fit, target = 0.95)
#> # A tibble: 32 × 4
#>    site  species threshold p_tp_at_threshold
#>    <chr> <chr>       <dbl>             <dbl>

# expected precision of the detections kept, from the selection tables
calibrated_thresholds(fit, target = 0.90, rule = "precision",
                      scored = scored)
